description: Business-to-business contact databases. Founders and employees are far more likely to be listed here than in consumer people-search sites.

brokers.name: Apollo.io
brokers.steps: Type the email, press 'Get verification information', then click the link sent to that inbox.
brokers.notes: No CAPTCHA seen. Accepts a personal Gmail address.

brokers.name: RocketReach
brokers.steps: Type the email, press 'Submit Request', then click the verification link emailed if a profile exists.
brokers.notes: No CAPTCHA seen. /opt_out is a 404; use /remove-profile.

brokers.name: Cognism
brokers.steps: Pick country and state, 'Delete my data', fill name, BUSINESS email, job title, company, phone, public LinkedIn URL, submit, then click the link (valid 7 days).
brokers.notes: Requires a business email and a LinkedIn URL. Same SayMine portal as Kaspr.

brokers.name: Kaspr
brokers.steps: Same form as Cognism, plus 'relationship with us' (choose Consumer). Click the emailed link within 7 days.
brokers.notes: Requires a business email and a LinkedIn URL.

brokers.name: ZoomInfo
brokers.steps: Open 'Request Removal' (privacyrequest.zoominfo.com/remove/verify). A one-time 'Press & Hold' bot check appears first; the user does it once, then the email form works for each address.
brokers.notes: Only emails instructions to addresses that match a profile. Submit every address the person uses.

brokers.name: Lusha
brokers.steps: Form is inside an iframe. Reason 'Other reasons', country, email, then the user ticks reCAPTCHA and submits. Lusha then emails a confirmation link that must be clicked.
brokers.notes: Fill the fields, leave the checkbox to the user.

brokers.name: Seamless.AI
brokers.steps: Select country and region, choose 'Delete My Information / Opt-Out', fill name, email, phone, relationship 'Business Contact', 'Deletion request', Review, then the user solves hCaptcha.
brokers.notes: Careful: the card layout shifts; a stray click can open the 'Correct My Information' form instead.

brokers.name: People Data Labs
brokers.steps: Full name, email, state of origin ('Other' for non-US/EU), reCAPTCHA by the user.
brokers.notes: This form only stops the sale/sharing of data. For deletion, email privacy@peopledatalabs.com.

brokers.name: SignalHire
brokers.steps: Form needs the exact profile URL, which needs an account to look up.
brokers.notes: Alternative: email support@signalhire.com asking to delete all data for the person's email addresses.

brokers.name: Hunter.io
brokers.notes: The browser extension had no permission for hunter.io in the pilot. Allow the site in the extension or do it by hand.

brokers.name: ContactOut
brokers.notes: No direct opt-out link found on /privacy. Look for a 'Do Not Sell My Info' control or email their privacy contact.
